claims.admissible_interpretation: vehicle composition rotates toward stable assets; count leadership is not sustained before 2026-Q2 and the backing mechanism is not homogeneous
claims.analysis_ready_panel: Four direct processed tables cover the exact released route calendar. The choices table has one ordered-endpoint, date, stable-or-native candidate, integration-scope, and ordered-venue-sequence cell with route counts plus raw, within-2x, and within-20-percent value support. The component-keyed choice-audit table independently reconciles every aggregate choice and its transaction multiplicity. The pair-support table reconciles source components to clean pair classifications and quarantined provider-coordinate collisions, carries unique-transaction and component-multiplicity diagnostics, and reports native and stable route counts plus matched within-20-percent counts and values within the conditional native-plus-stable choice set. These conditional native-plus-stable values are not a strict-value measure of the full market. The exclusions table records every route outside the primary choice object in mutually exclusive reason cells and retains component-keyed collision evidence with count, observed absolute leg-value, time, and venue bounds.
claims.dependent_variable: stable share of native-plus-stable conditional choice mass measured by route count, matched within-20-percent route count, and within-20-percent intermediation value

market_incidence_decomposition.calendar_support: month-days observed in both endpoint years
market_incidence_decomposition.common_role_definition: an ordered endpoint pair with positive primary-choice mass in both endpoint years
market_incidence_decomposition.forbidden_interpretations: architecture availability, opportunity-set change, demand, adoption, preference, routing-search efficiency or causal treatment
market_incidence_decomposition.formula: First bridge the all-pair stable-share change to pairs with positive M in both years and then to pairs with positive primary-choice mass in both years; these two differences are market_pair_support_bridge and vehicle_role_support_bridge. On common-role pairs define F(M,I,s)=sum_p M_p I_p s_p / sum_p M_p I_p. market_activity_reweighting, vehicle_incidence_reweighting and within_pair_stable_share are each factor's average marginal contribution across all six permutations taking F from the 2024 factor vector to the 2026 factor vector.
market_incidence_decomposition.identity: delta_total = market_pair_support_bridge + vehicle_role_support_bridge + market_activity_reweighting + vehicle_incidence_reweighting + within_pair_stable_share
market_incidence_decomposition.market_activity: M_p,y equals released market_route_count aggregated over the common calendar and measures observed market-route activity, not availability or a feasible opportunity set
market_incidence_decomposition.pair_universe: union of ordered endpoint pairs with positive native-plus-stable primary-choice mass in either endpoint year
reporting: year-specific support mass and stable share by support class
common-role Shapley components and exact bridge identity
market_incidence_decomposition.stable_share: s_p,y equals stable_choice_route_count divided by primary_choice_route_count conditional on a positive realised vehicle role
support_classification: market_pair_support_turnover when the other endpoint year has zero M
vehicle_role_support_turnover_established_market when the other endpoint year has positive M and zero primary-choice mass
common_vehicle_role when primary-choice mass is positive in both endpoint years
market_incidence_decomposition.vehicle_incidence: I_p,y equals primary_choice_route_count divided by M_p,y and measures realised native-or-stable vehicle-route incidence, not adoption, preference or search

pair_decomposition.calendar_support: month-days observed in both endpoint years
pair_decomposition.common_pair_definition: an ordered endpoint pair with positive selected-measure native-plus-stable mass in both endpoint years after restricting to common month-days and pooling integration scopes
pair_decomposition.denominator_scope: native-plus-stable conditional choice mass for the selected measure
pair_decomposition.exclusive_pair_definition: an ordered endpoint pair with positive selected-measure native-plus-stable mass in exactly one endpoint year after restricting to common month-days and pooling integration scopes
pair_decomposition.formula: For each measure, let W_y be common-pair mass as a share of total native-plus-stable conditional mass, E_y = 1 - W_y, q_p,y the weight of common pair p within common-pair mass, s_p,y its stable share, S_C,y = sum_p q_p,y s_p,y, and S_E,y the stable share within year-exclusive-pair mass. Using bars for endpoint-year midpoints: within_common = W_bar sum_p q_p_bar (s_p,2026 - s_p,2024); common_pair_reweighting = W_bar sum_p s_p_bar (q_p,2026 - q_p,2024); common_support_mass = (S_C_bar - S_E_bar) (W_2026 - W_2024); exclusive_pair_contribution = E_bar (S_E,2026 - S_E,2024)
pair_decomposition.pair_membership_id: measure_specific; pooled reporting assigns membership after summing integration scopes and scope-specific reporting assigns membership within each scope
pair_decomposition.pair_universe: union of ordered endpoint pairs with positive native-plus-stable conditional mass in either endpoint year on the common calendar
pair_decomposition.zero_exclusive_mass_rule: set S_E,y to zero when E_y is zero, retain the exact identity, and report common-support-mass and exclusive-contribution terms jointly because their separate values then depend on this normalization

pair_panel.effective_cell_weight: with two endpoint-year observations per saturated cell, denominator-mass WLS weights the within-cell 2026-minus-2024 difference in proportion to w_2024 times w_2026 divided by (w_2024 plus w_2026)

claims.decision_rule: Only the full V2-family calendar adjudicates the claim; pre- and post-Uniswap-V3 estimates are heterogeneity and cannot rescue it. An exact reciprocal route/capital measure pair passes when both route-to-capital and capital-to-route coefficients are positive with Holm q below 0.05 at the same at least two of 1, 7, and 30 days and neither direction is significantly negative at 120 days. The claim passes when at least one exact pair passes and, for that route measure, both the log-dollar and five-candidate-share capital alternatives have positive median coefficients in each direction across the three primary horizons with no significantly negative primary coefficient
claims.dependent_variable: in the route-to-capital direction, exact-horizon change in candidate-attributed deposited capital or its five-candidate share; in the capital-to-route direction, exact-horizon change in intermediary episode share or the endpoint-supported vehicle excess-use count ratio

global_rules.abstract_question: what makes a vehicle currency dominant, not what makes an asset a vehicle currency
global_rules.asset_identity: canonical contract address; symbols are labels only
global_rules.audit_sampling: one transaction-state day near the middle of each calendar month is an estimator-validation snapshot only; it does not define a monthly estimand, a persistence sample, or a structural-break sample
global_rules.causal_language: permitted only after timing, pretrend, balance, exclusion, and placebo gates pass
global_rules.cost_domination: a route-level comparison in which an available alternative returns more at the same reconstructed pre-trade state and exact input size after fees and gas; never call this dominance without the cost qualifier
global_rules.dynamic_horizons: final dynamic estimation uses daily exact-state observations linked by exact calendar dates at 1, 7, 30, and 120 days; calendar months and row shifts are not substitutes
global_rules.inference: two-sided 95 percent intervals; HAC lag 30 days for daily series; clustering at the economic assignment level for panels
global_rules.intermediary_unit: one non-endpoint asset occurrence on a topology-valid clean-leg route
global_rules.missing_data: retain topology-valid counts; unsupported values contribute zero and remain visible in coverage
global_rules.multiplicity: Holm adjustment within each claim's primary coefficient family
global_rules.primary_vehicle_choice_unit: one exact two-leg intermediary route, which has one vehicle and one vote
global_rules.prose_gate: a registered claim enters final prose only after its declared outputs are rebuilt from its declared inputs after this lock
global_rules.round_trips: canonical endpoint round trips are excluded from economic-route numerators and denominators
global_rules.route_unit: one directed economic input-to-output path keyed by transaction hash and component id
global_rules.value_weighting: secondary, with raw, within-2x, and within-20-percent support reported separately
global_rules.vehicle_dominance: continuous: the degree of vehicle use, measured by intermediary share and normalized by endpoint-demand share as the excess-use ratio
global_rules.vehicle_status: binary: an asset has vehicle status on a route if it is used as a non-endpoint intermediary
